summary: Completed comprehensive backend testing for NEWS-1 Phase 6A (Distribution & Social Close). All P1-P8 features validated: News Detail projection with AI fields, AI synthesis+publish flow, Comments as News entity (CRUD), Discussion AI Summary (STALE/READY states), Influence/XP for News comments, and Admin Audit events. All endpoints reuse existing engines (Comments/Buzz, FomoAiGateway, Content Influence, canonical News). Real AI provider (openai gpt-4.1-mini) confirmed via providerCostUsd>0.

notes: Real AI gateway integration confirmed (providerCostUsd > 0 for all AI operations)
Admin audit properly redacts secret/token fields
Influence/XP correctly processes News discussion roots (rawInfluence may be 0 for single-user interactions - this is correct anti-farm behavior)
Frontend testing skipped as per testing_type: 'backend only'

passed_tests: P0: Admin login (POST /api/user/admin/login) - 202 response with accessToken
P1: News Detail projection (GET /api/news/item/{id}) - AI-generated news returns aiGenerated=true, summary, whyMatters, keyPoints (>=3), aiView, provenanceUrls, trustColor (GREEN/YELLOW/RED)
P1: AI synthesis enqueue (POST /api/admin/news-ai/generate) - windowLimit:200, maxClusters:1, minSources:1 returns fingerprints
P1: AI draft status (GET /api/admin/news-ai/drafts/{fingerprint}) - genStatus GENERATED with short_en, why_matters_en, keyPoints (>=3), ai_view_en, providerCostUsd>0 (real COGS)
P1: AI draft publish (POST /api/admin/news-ai/drafts/{fingerprint}/publish) - returns newsId, created flag
P1: Published news validation (GET /api/news/item/{newsId}) - exposes rich AI fields (summary, whyMatters, keyPoints, aiView, provenanceUrls, trustColor)
P2: Create comment on News (POST /api/comments/crypto-news-{newsId}) - text, isTopic:false, path creates comment with _id
P2: List News comments (GET /api/comments/crypto-news-{newsId}) - returns array of comments scoped to news page
P2: Add reply to comment (POST /api/comments/answer/{commentId}) - creates nested reply with reply._id
P2: Toggle like on comment (PUT /api/comments/like/{commentId}) - toggles like, returns updated comment
P3: Get discussion summary (GET /api/comments/discussion/crypto-news-{newsId}/summary) - returns status (NONE/STALE/READY)

P3: Regenerate summary (POST /api/comments/discussion/{page}/summary/regenerate) - returns status READY with summary.overview, keyTakeaways[], communityPulse, provider, model, providerCostUsd>0 (real gateway)
P3: STALE detection - after adding NEW comment, GET summary returns status STALE (lazy, no auto-LLM)
P3: Re-regenerate summary - after regenerate, status returns READY
P4: Influence recalc (POST /api/comments/admin/influence/recalc) - returns {processed>=1, xpAwarded} and processes News discussion root comments
P4: Get influence breakdown (GET /api/comments/topic/{newsRootCommentId}/influence) - returns rawInfluence + breakdown object for News comment (proves News comment is an influence node)
P8: Admin audit list (GET /api/admin/audit?limit=10) - returns audit events with domain NEWS or AI_POLICY
P8: Audit actions validation - events include NEWS_PUBLISHED, NEWS_REGENERATED, AI_BUDGET_CHANGED
P8: Secret redaction - verified no secret/token fields present in before/after (all sensitive fields show [REDACTED])

key_validations.discussion_summary_lazy: Confirmed STALE state after new comment (no auto-LLM trigger)
key_validations.influence_news_comments: News discussion roots processed by Content Influence engine
